query: insert into leads (id, event_id, device_id, submitted_at, first_name, last_name, email, phone, custom_answers, consent_at, consent_text, spam_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $4, $10, $11) on conflict (id) do update set event_id = excluded.event_id, device_id = excluded.device_id, submitted_at = excluded.submitted_at, first_name = excluded.first_name, last_name = excluded.last_name, email = excluded.email, phone = excluded.phone, custom_answers = excluded.custom_answers, consent_at = excluded.consent_at, consent_text = excluded.consent_text, spam_at = excluded.spam_at
